description: Write or change CI pipelines (GitHub Actions or GitLab CI) that run the project's real build, lint, and test commands with dependency caching, a version matrix where useful, least-privilege permissions, pinned actions, and safe handling of secrets and untrusted input. Use when the user asks to add, change, speed up, or fix the configuration of a CI workflow, job, or pipeline, including adding a publish, release, or deploy job, which this skill gates. Do not use for diagnosing why an existing run failed (use agent-kit:ci-triage), for security hardening of existing workflows (use agent-kit:hardening), or for Dockerfiles (use agent-kit:dockerfile).
